# D2 Windows integration machine

Original synthetic metadata, assembled from the authored uninstall and Start Menu corpora plus minimal public launcher file formats. No host installation, account, registry export, executable or copyrighted game data is copied. Files named .exe/.dll are labelled inert text and are never run. Public product names in the 100-record classifier corpus are representative labels, not installation captures.

The authored expected.json enumerates logical games before scanning. Duplicate Steam/Epic/GOG/EA/Ubisoft/Battle.net uninstall records and GameUX/Start Menu entries must join their owning game. Spacewar is an orphan launcher alias. Agent/client/runtime and uninstalled entries are intentional negatives. Xbox uses a generated RGBX marker on drive D, a MicrosoftGame.config and Appx manifest with matching identity.
